reserveReview.rationale: Reviewed Hydration's HOLLAR and Borrow documentation on 2026-10-01 and read the token at Hydration block 15249643. The token registers five facilitators: Hydration Market, HOLLAR FlashMinter, HOLLAR Stability Module, GIGAHDX, and BIL. Their bucket capacities and levels describe mint authority and liabilities, not collateral holdings or asset weights. Public documentation names eligible collateral and HSM yield strategies but does not provide a dated complete allocation spanning these paths. Keep the unresolved aggregate and known-unknown exposure at 100%; this review does not refresh the composition date.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Hydration's documented HOLLAR collateral set; current per-asset and HSM-versus-borrow-market weights are unpublished
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: A complete dated collateral and HSM-asset denominator is not established. Current facilitator bucket levels do not reveal per-asset reserve weights, HSM holdings, GIGAHDX/BIL collateral coverage, cross-venue debt, or double-counting adjustments.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is held in on-chain borrow-market and HSM contracts on the Hydration appchain with automated per-block partial liquidations rather than a conventional custodian. Legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation concepts do not map to this non-custodial structure; operative risks are runtime governance and smart-contract integrity.
